lines: 51 clicks and 7,174 impressions in the 7 days to 2026-09-18, vs 37 clicks and 7,595 impressions the prior week (clicks up 38%, impressions down 6%).

Top queries by clicks: bariatric counseling center (3 clicks, #6.6); will dehydration cause weight loss (1 click, #1.3); food rehab (1 click, #12.0).

Top pages: /healthy-living-2/why-hydration-is-essential-for-weight-loss-and-management/ (21 clicks, 3,316 impressions); /self-improvement/mental-health/how-to-improve-self-esteem-while-losing-weight-the-healthy-way/ (10 clicks, 471 impressions); / (4 clicks, 163 impressions).
Page-one query with the worst click rate: can dehydration cause weight loss, #2.8, 39 impressions, 0.0% CTR. A sharper title or description is the cheapest fix.
